description: Google Maps route map: load the Maps JS API via @googlemaps/js-api-loader, draw the intercity route polyline through the overnight bases, animate a car marker along the route, and sync/show live user location (opt-in) via Supabase Realtime. MUST degrade gracefully to a static styled route panel when the Maps key is absent so build and mock mode never crash. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-003 (shell + seed route).
steps: Create src/lib/maps/* : a loader wrapper around @googlemaps/js-api-loader keyed on NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (referrer-restricted key, safe to expose), route coordinates derived from the seed overnight bases (Tempe, Sedona, Grand Canyon South Rim, San Diego, Los Angeles/Griffith, San Francisco), and a `mapsAvailable` boolean.

Build src/app/(app)/map/page.tsx + src/components/map/* : when mapsAvailable, render the Google map, draw the route polyline, and animate a car marker interpolating along the polyline (requestAnimationFrame). Add a live-location toggle that, when granted, publishes the user position over Supabase Realtime and renders other participants' markers (only when supabaseAvailable).

Implement the degraded fallback: when mapsAvailable is false, render a styled static panel listing the route legs (from seed) with a clear 'add a Maps key to see the live map' note — no exceptions thrown, no blank screen.
Commit locally: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: google maps route map with animated car marker and live location"`.
acceptance_criteria: With NO Maps key, `npm run build` passes and /map renders the static fallback panel (listing the seed route legs) without errors.
The animated-marker code path and live-location publish/subscribe typecheck and are guarded by mapsAvailable/supabaseAvailable.
`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build` pass with no .env.local.
